name: omp-pi-anchored-standard
description: Anchored tool catalog for omp and pi: first request exposes a task-routed bootstrap catalog (default deepseek-v4-pro, routerMode standard/spec), a capped output budget, and the DSH minimal/route persona; full catalog or resident set + normal budget after the first durable promotion signal. Port of xiaobright/dsh-anchored-standard via dbydd/pi-anchored-tool-for-dspro, with dsh-router-standard task routing.
